verdict.rationale: Greptile's only relevant claim is a general one: it reviews every PR with "complete understanding of your codebase" [greptile-docs-1]. That implies whole-repo context, which bears on large monorepos, but nothing addresses changes spanning multiple repositories. Community reports of indexing failures and a search bug on a large many-branch repo [greptile-comm-4][greptile-comm-6] temper confidence but do not concretely contradict cross-repo review. Missing for 10: any documented multi-repo or cross-repository PR review capability, explicit monorepo scale or handling docs, and independent hands-on evidence of coherent reviews of large or cross-repo changes.
